# owen-session-1

The user opened by setting default presentation preferences for any materials prepared for them: HTML format, large text, and Irish language [cite:owen-001]. The assistant acknowledged it would retain these preferences for future work [cite:owen-002]. The user also mentioned enjoying a documentary about ocean currents, explicitly noting this did not change the project's scope [cite:owen-003].

sessions/owen-session-2/summary.md.content:
# owen-session-2

The user confirmed the first approved appointment of the volunteer training tour: meeting Reed Rescue in Galway on 2027-03-17 [cite:owen-004]. The assistant floated a possible additional visit to Limerick, explicitly framing it as only its own suggestion, not a booking or user decision [cite:owen-005]. The user instructed that no extra cities be booked and that suggestions be kept separate from confirmed appointments [cite:owen-006].

sessions/owen-session-3/summary.md.content:
# owen-session-3

The user confirmed a second organization for the tour: Beacon Volunteers in Cork, while noting that no date had been agreed for it yet [cite:owen-007]. The user also assigned coordination ownership: Asha owns coordinating the first visit, and the user will coordinate the second visit themselves [cite:owen-008]. The assistant summarized that the plan now had two confirmed organizations, with dates and owners as separate facts [cite:owen-009].

sessions/owen-session-4/summary.md.content:
# owen-session-4

The user issued a correction to the first visit: Reed Rescue in Galway moved from 2027-03-17 to 2027-03-20 because the venue is closed for maintenance on the original date; the organization and coordinator were unchanged [cite:owen-010]. The assistant gave a historical recap only, noting 2027-03-17 was the old date and not the current one [cite:owen-011]. The user also made an unrelated request to compare two ways to organize a bookshelf, stating it was not a request to change travel preferences [cite:owen-012].

sessions/owen-session-5/summary.md.content:
# owen-session-5

The user requested a briefing showing the confirmed organizations, the current first-visit date, and its coordinator, using their existing document preferences [cite:owen-013]. The assistant proposed switching the briefing to PNG and adding Limerick, labeling these as unapproved suggestions [cite:owen-014]. The user rejected both, instructing that the original document preferences be kept and confirming the Limerick addition was not approved [cite:owen-015].
